question: Can I carry forward unused casual leave to the next year?
expected_answer: Yes. Up to 5 unused casual leaves can be carried forward to the next calendar year, and any balance above 5 lapses on 31 December. Carried forward casual leave must be used by 31 March of the following year.

question: I feel sick this morning and cannot come to work. What should I do?
expected_answer: Inform your manager by phone or message before the start of the working day, and apply for the leave in the HR portal within 2 working days of returning.

question: I joined recently and I am still on probation. Which leaves can I take, and do I earn earned leave?
expected_answer: Employees on probation receive casual leave and sick leave from their date of joining, pro-rated for the remaining months of the calendar year. Earned leave does not accrue during probation and starts accruing after confirmation.

question: I want to take two weeks of earned leave in a row. How early do I need to apply?
expected_answer: Earned leave of more than 5 consecutive days must be applied for at least 10 working days in advance.

question: How many sick leaves do I get in a year?
expected_answer: Every employee is entitled to 10 sick leaves per calendar year.

question: Can I carry the unused ones forward?
expected_answer: No. Unused sick leave lapses on 31 December and cannot be carried forward.

question: Can I use my personal phone to read my company email?
expected_answer: Yes, but only through the approved mobile management app. Company source code and Restricted data must never be stored on personal devices.

question: My company laptop was stolen. What do I need to do and how quickly?
expected_answer: Report it to the IT helpdesk within 2 hours of discovering the loss. In case of theft, also file a police report and share a copy with IT within 24 hours.

question: Can I paste a confidential company document into a public AI tool to summarise it?
expected_answer: No. Confidential and Restricted data must never be uploaded to public AI tools or file sharing sites, or sent to personal email. It must only be shared through approved company tools.

question: I received a suspicious email. What should I do with it?
expected_answer: Forward it to the security team at security@acmetech.example and then delete it. If you suspect a data breach or malware infection, report it to the IT helpdesk immediately and do not try to investigate or fix it yourself.

question: Where do I need multi-factor authentication, and can I use SMS codes?
expected_answer: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for company email, the VPN and the HR portal, using the company-approved authenticator app. SMS codes are not allowed except as a temporary fallback.

question: Can I fly business class on a business trip?
expected_answer: Economy class must be booked for all flights. Business class is allowed only for directors and above on flights longer than 6 hours.

question: How much will I be reimbursed if I use my own two-wheeler for a business trip?
expected_answer: Use of a personal vehicle for business travel needs manager approval. The reimbursement rate is Rs. 5 per km for two-wheelers, and toll and parking charges are reimbursed on receipts.

question: How long do I have to submit my expense claim after a trip ends?
expected_answer: Expense claims must be submitted in the expense portal within 30 days of the end of the trip. Claims submitted after 30 days need approval from the department head and may be rejected.

question: I am going on an international business trip. What approvals do I need and how much meal allowance will I get?
expected_answer: All business travel must be approved by the reporting manager in the expense portal before any booking is made, and international travel also needs approval from the department head. The meal allowance for international travel is USD 50 per day, a fixed amount that does not need receipts.

question: Can I claim alcohol when I take a client out for dinner?
expected_answer: No. Alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances. Client meals and entertainment are reimbursed up to Rs. 2,500 per person with prior manager approval.

question: What are the standard working hours, and when do I have to be available?
expected_answer: Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday, with a 1 hour lunch break. Employees must be available during core hours from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM, and start and end times may be adjusted with manager approval.

question: A client gave me a gift worth Rs. 3,000. What should I do?
expected_answer: Gifts from vendors or clients worth more than Rs. 2,000 must be declared to the Compliance team within 7 days of receiving them. Cash or cash equivalents must never be accepted as gifts.

question: How long do I have to file a harassment complaint, and how long does the inquiry take?
expected_answer: Complaints can be made to the Internal Committee in writing within 3 months of the incident. The Internal Committee completes its inquiry within 90 days.

question: Can I do freelance consulting work on weekends?
expected_answer: Employees must get written approval from HR before taking outside employment, consulting work or a board position. Working for a competitor, client or vendor is not permitted.
